subject: megaman
about: SoulT+1 lengthens no Beast Out (the owner's call of 10 November 2026: Souls only, docs/game/navicust.md, 11): beast_out's battle with BN5's SoulT+1, BN6's program 48, placed on BN6's own NaviCust board and compiled by BN6 before the battle (ncp6: his NaviStats' extra turns 1, as soul_soult has them). Beast Out lasts its three turns all the same, to the frame.
expect_why: beast_out's own course, unchanged: BN6 times a Beast Out by its counter (battle NaviStats +0x21), which program 48's routine does not touch; the byte it sets (+0x32) reaches only the Cross record's turns through 0x0802A118 (0x08015952's third argument, +3), which no code of Gregar's reads, and the engine's Souls (soulunite.c). So the form is 0x0B to t1563 and MegaMan's own from t1564, as without the program.
